from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of papers referenced in this document's bibliography. These should match the titles of the provided papers in the collection.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all papers from the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
